errorCodes.meaning: The authenticated caller is not a member of this community.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

personhood.description: Whether the renewed membership carries a personhood assertion.

personhoodChanged.description: Whether the personhood state changed on this renewal.

roleVac.description: The freshly-issued role credential (opaque here): a Verifiable Authority Credential (`type` including `AuthorityCredential`) issued by the community with `issuerScope` `public`, whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }` — the shape vtc/vetting/vetters/grant/0.1 issues.

vmc.description: The freshly-issued W3C Verifiable Membership Credential (opaque here).
